description.sub_name: 航空器系統工程管理–理論與實務
description.sub_ename: AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS ENGINEERING MANAGEMENT–THEORY AND PRACTICE
description.describe_ch: 介紹航空器系統研究發展及生命週期過程中應用到的各項技術及作為，包括風險管理、專案管理、型態管理、驗證與確認等使學生瞭解飛機系統工程管理概念與實務。
description.describe_eh: Introduce the research, development and life cycle management of the aircraft system techniques and actions, including the risk management, project management, configuration management, and verification and validation, etc. to enable students to understand the concepts of system engineering management.
